concepts.role: style concept only; no production crop
style concept only; no production crop

scope: Cove-only water B and soft sand; existing 8px surface cue band

geometry.anchor: surface y is native row0; depth below only
geometry.reason: all five authored material spans are flat; preserve adjacent slopes and ownership
geometry.collisionEndpointRule: actual movement surfaceAt gives first inclusive segment ownership at shared endpoints; no changes

sourceRequest.scaleStatus: requested target, NOT returned-pixel fact; source crops must independently prove equal x/y scale and common grain
sourceRequest.layoutStatus: requested positions ONLY; inspect actual source before fixing crops
sourceRequest.background: true alpha preferred; otherwise uniform pure #ff00ff with no art magenta

prepared.format: RGBA PNG, straight alpha, zero RGB at alpha0
prepared.sourceScaleRule: one measured isotropic source/native scale shared across all water modules; one across all sand modules, target6 for both. No fit-whole-component anisotropic squeeze. Refinement if incoherent.

repeats.worldAnchor: world x, never camera x; use true periodic source or deterministic mirror if independently seam-safe
repeats.widthAssembly: native end caps plus full or partial repeat crops; never stretch. Prefer prepare complete fixed-width strips to avoid internal fractional-camera gaps.

fullStrips.waterRippleLayers: each width+2 by4, at local y2, 1px horizontal sampling guard each side; alpha feather to zero inside both existing end caps

prepared.alpha: gutter alpha0; water/sand readable interior, bottom2rows and outer end tips blend into unchanged ground; no holes mistaken for new collision edges. Existing prepared ground stays opaque below. Cream highlights retained.
prepared.verification: source PNG dimensions/hash, measured crop bounds/top, equal scale ratios, actual-source alpha/core/base columns, no chroma fringe, actual repeated joins/cap joins/partial widths, separate deterministic reproduction pixel hashes

paletteTargets.note: direction targets, not mandatory sampled concept pixels; subtle teal and warm cream distinct from dry banks and each other; no dark hazard rim

motion.input: existing drawWorld runSeconds and reducedMotion only
motion.baseAndEnds: static world position, alpha and dimensions; only generated ripple layer moves
motion.pause: same frozen runSeconds => exact same pixels; no Date.now, performance.now, RAF clock, timer, state mutation or gameplay tick
motion.cachedPreview: existing drawWorld time0/reducedMotiontrue keeps actual cached canvas static

pins.baselineRecords: never edit preserved-files.json, geometry-pin.json, old preparation/source provenance; add new materials provenance separately

acceptance: source/concept/asset proofs are distinct from actual normal-input game captures; owner test preview still requires fresh review and explicit visual inspection
